commands.review_summary:
The branch passes Together provider `request` config into video create-request HTTP config and adds a regression test for configured private-network/header overrides.

PR surface: Source +2, Tests +68. Total +70 across 2 files.

Reproducibility: yes. at source level: current main omits Together provider request overrides, and the PR fixes only the create request while the unchanged poll/download paths remain visible in the same module. I did not run live provider validation in this read-only review.
commands.review_followup: - [P2] A bounded provider-local repair can complete the same request-policy propagation through Together poll/download paths without a product decision.

target.title: fix(together): apply configured request policy to video generation requests
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Together video generation currently ignores `models.providers.together.request` overrides (headers, allowPrivateNetwork, dispatcherPolicy). Users who configure a request policy for Together see it applied to chat/completion providers but not to video generation, so private-network access, custom headers, and dispatcher routing are dropped on the floor.

## Why This Change Was Made

Mirror the pattern already used by `openai`, `pixverse`, `google` image generation, and Alix-007's recent DashScope/MiniMax/OpenRouter video request-policy PRs: pass `sanitizeConfiguredModelProviderRequest(providerConfig?.request)` into `resolveProviderHttpRequestConfig` so the configured transport overrides flow into the create request.

## Changes

- `extensions/together/video-generation-provider.ts`
  - Import `sanitizeConfiguredModelProviderRequest`.
  - Read `req.cfg?.models?.providers?.together`.
  - Forward the sanitized request policy to `resolveProviderHttpRequestConfig`.
  - Remove the hard-coded `allowPrivateNetwork: false` so `request.allowPrivateNetwork` can take effect.
- `extensions/together/video-generation-provider.test.ts`
  - Add regression test asserting that configured `allowPrivateNetwork` and headers reach `postJsonRequest`.

## Intentionally Out of Scope

- Poll/download stages continue to use the headers resolved at create time; this change does not refactor them onto `fetchWithTimeoutGuarded`, matching the minimal scope of the existing video request-policy PRs.
- No new helper or shared abstraction is introduced.

## Evidence

```bash
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/together/video-generation-provider.test.ts
node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p test/tsconfig/tsconfig.extensions.test.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile .artifacts/tsgo-cache/extensions-test.tsbuildinfo
node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p tsconfig.extensions.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile .artifacts/tsgo-cache/extensions.tsbuildinfo
node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs --tsconfig config/tsconfig/oxlint.extensions.json extensions/together/video-generation-provider.ts extensions/together/video-generation-provider.test.ts
```

- Vitest: 9/9 passing.
- `tsgo` (source + test): no type errors.
- `oxlint`: clean.

Real behavior proof against a local Together-compatible endpoint, showing the configured `X-Together-Policy` header is sent and private-network access is allowed:

```
[proof] local Together-compatible endpoint at http://127.0.0.1:38321
[server] POST /videos
[server] Authorization: Bearer dummy-together-key
[server] X-Together-Policy: together-policy
[server] GET /videos/video-proof
[server] GET /video.mp4
[proof] generated video count: 1
[proof] video MIME type: video/mp4
[proof] done
```
